description: This file defines an abstract servlet filter class 'StartupFilter' used during application startup in the OpenMRS platform. It manages initialization procedures, rendering of setup templates, handling of static resource requests, and integration with Velocity templating engine. The class is designed to facilitate pre-spring startup logic such as setup screens or initialization steps.

classes.name: StartupFilter
classes.description: An abstract servlet filter class used during OpenMRS startup to handle initialization, static resource serving, redirecting to setup pages, and rendering templates with Velocity.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Handles the filtering logic for each request, including health checks, static resource serving, redirects, and delegating GET/POST requests to subclasses.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter, setting up Velocity engine for templating.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the filter is destroyed. (No implementation here)

methods.name: renderTemplate
methods.description: Renders a Velocity template with provided context and model data, serving HTML responses.

methods.name: getTemplatePrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix path for locating Velocity templates, defaulting to 'org/openmrs/web/filter/'.

methods.name: getUpdateFilterModel
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the form/backing object used in templates.

methods.name: skipFilter
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the filter should be skipped for the given request.

methods.name: addLogLinesToResponse
methods.description: Adds the last 5 log lines from OpenMRS logging to a response map for display.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Converts an object to its JSON string representation for JavaScript.

methods.name: getToolContext
methods.description: Returns or creates a Velocity ToolContext configured with localization tools for the provided locale.
